Official ISDOC 6.0.2 invoice schema, downloaded from https://isdoc.github.io/xsd/isdoc-invoice-6.0.2.xsd.
Copyright and redistribution notice are preserved in the XSD. See https://isdoc.github.io/ for the specification.
The ISDOC generator tests validate CZK/EUR and each VAT treatment with `xmllint` (`libxml2-utils` on Linux, included on macOS).
